description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Forgotten' within the Opencart admin mail controller namespace. The class handles the process of generating and sending a password reset email after a user requests password recovery. It loads necessary models and language resources, constructs email content, and schedules a mail task.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class handling forgotten password email process within the admin mail module of OpenCart.

methods.description: Main method invoked to process the password reset request, validate arguments, generate email content, and schedule the email task.
